newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end sharply up on stock rise.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end sharply up on stock rise.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed sharply higher on Friday as funds streamed out of the banking system into the recently red hot market, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate closed at 7.789 percent against Thursday's 7.217 close -- far above the central bank's target zone of 5.0-5.5 percent -- with 30-day commercial paper soaring to 7.25-7.50 against 7.00-7.25.
The rejuvenated stock market, capping a two-week-long bull run, skyrocketted 2.85 percent on Friday to finish at a seven-year high of 8,882.13.
Dealers said the rates would rise further if the stock market rally continued.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 5.8470-8540 percent against 5.8350-8370.
